ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central field with a continuous dark pigmentation band along the trailing edge. Numerous low-intensity linear streaks (rake marks) are distributed across the white background, primarily in vertical and diagonal orientations.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate 75-degree pixel angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations visible along the entire trailing edge boundary, characterized by sharp peaks and shallow valleys with varying pixel-amplitudes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave trailing edge curve leading to tapered, acutely angled distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized dark pixel clusters visible at the distal tips and along the trailing edge serrations, suggesting scarring or barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense distribution of dark, non-parallel linear streaks (rake marks) concentrated heavily on the left lobe and lower central region of the fluke.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant scarring from rake marks across the ventral surface and irregular, slightly ragged distal tips indicating prior physical abrasion.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a high-contrast text overlay in the bottom third of the frame containing metadata: 'JAC96-15/18 ID 13552 JOHN CALAMBOKIDIS S# N-6 06 July 96 Washington'.
